citation: C. Donahue, H. H. Mao, J. McAuley. The NES Music Database: A multi-instrumental dataset with expressive performance attributes. ISMIR 2018.
license_note: The nesmdb software repository is open source, but the underlying game compositions are third-party copyrighted works. Research use only until a rights review is completed (proposal 5.5). Do not ship models or audio derived from this data commercially without that review.
notes: URLs are Google Drive direct-download links derived from the file ids on the
homepage. Drive serves files under ~100 MB without an interstitial, so the
MIDI and score releases download straight through; the larger ones may not.
If a download fails, fetch the archive in a browser and register it with
The midi sha256 below was computed from the archive this project ingested;
the homepage also publishes checksums on its download links.

midi.description: Four-channel MIDI representation (P1, P2, TR, NO).

exprsco.description: Expressive score on a 24 Hz grid. The release to train on: the MIDI release is sample-timed performance data with no musical grid.

vgm.description: Raw VGM recordings, the reference audio for renderer A/B testing.
